title: Annual Values as of 2022 Used to Determine Eligibility for Social Support Schemes in 2023
what_it_is: Annual Values as of 2022 Used to Determine Eligibility for Social Support Schemes in 2023

sections.label: Annual Values and social support
sections.summary: Communication plans assure seniors that social support schemes are unaffected by 2023 Annual Value revisions, with 2022 values used for 2023 eligibility.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
sentences.text: asked the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance with the revision of Annual Values (AV) of most residential properties in 2023 (a) what are the communication plans to seniors that social support schemes will not be affected by this revision, as AVs as of 2022 will be used to determine scheme eligibility in 2023; and (b) what are the plans for scheme eligibility for 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: We are also working with the Silver Generation Office (SGO) to engage seniors and provide them this assurance.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: For many of our social support schemes, no application is required and Singaporeans receive the support automatically as long as they are eligible.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: These include the cash payments and MediSave top-ups under the GST Voucher scheme and the Assurance Package.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The Government regularly reviews our social support schemes, including the AV thresholds, to ensure that Singaporeans in need of support receive it.

sections.label: Silver Generation senior outreach
sections.summary: Silver Generation Ambassadors' face-to-face interactions and mass media help explain schemes and eligibility to seniors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The face-to-face interactions between our Silver Generation Ambassadors and the seniors would be helpful, to explain to them some of these schemes and what they are eligible for.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: We also rely on other means of communications, including the mass media.
